rows.note: Use this when the analogy is an illustrative comparison used to explain an idea.

example.english: This analogy makes it easy to understand, explaining the complicated concept as if it were building blocks.
example.traditional: 呢個比喻好易明，將個複雜概念講到好似砌積木咁。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bei2 jyu6 hou2 ji6 ming4 zoeng1 go3 fuk1 zaap6 goi3 nim6 gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 cai3 zik1 muk6 gam2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose equivalent for a relationship of analogy, especially in technical or formal discussion.

example.english: This theory can use analogy to explain the behaviour of two kinds of particles.
example.traditional: 呢個理論可以用類比去解釋兩種粒子嘅行為。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 ho2 ji5 jung6 leoi6 bei2 heoi3 gaai2 sik1 loeng5 zung2 lap1 zi2 ge3 hang4 wai4
